name: Mila Evans
source: A girl [url=/c19742]Kyle[/url] sees on the road while traveling to Hotel Dusk. When she arrives at the hotel, Kyle learns she cannot speak. She wears a bracelet identical to the one [url=/c149563]Bradley[/url] wore.
